plan.why: Alexander leads applied AI at AMD with a focus on software engineering lifecycle improvements and developer experience, aligning with Henry's interest in building AI-driven entertainment IP and creator tools. Meeting him offers insights into enterprise-scale AI application and potential collaborations in AI agent development.

Mention Henry's experience in entertainment production, such as the BLACKPINK shoot, to connect on creative content and technology integration.
Emphasize the goal of networking with builders focused on AI agents and developer tools at GitHub Universe, inviting a technical and innovation-focused exchange.
openers: Hi Alex, I’m Henry Finn from Unicorn Studios in San Francisco. I’m really interested in how AI is shaping both entertainment and developer experiences. How do you see AI evolving in the software lifecycle at AMD?

Hello Alexander, I’m exploring AI applications in creative content and came across your session on using AI at enterprise scale. I’d love to hear your thoughts on measuring AI impact beyond just saved hours.
plan.followUp: Thank you for the insights today, Alex. Looking forward to exploring synergies between AMD’s applied AI work and our developments in AI-driven entertainment IP at Unicorn Studios.
